method: Systematic verification of every substantive factual claim via live WebSearch (training cutoff Jan 2026; must-verify on live web). Three parallel pre-research agents (model releases / leaderboards / macro) produced dated, sourced findings. Manuscript drafted from those. Then a dedicated fact-check Explore agent re-verified every date, parameter count, license, benchmark score, price, CVE, and organizational action against live URLs. Hedges retained on all vendor-stated benchmark numbers.
gate: PASS — no unresolved CORRECTED claims. TTS spend authorized.
